primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in mean liver triglyceride levels at EOT (Day 57) or early termination.
efficacy_outcome: Percent changes were −0.68% (200 mg/day), −0.28% (400 mg/day), 0.65% (800 mg/day), and 6.36% (placebo); reported p-values were 0.222, 0.133, and 0.302.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events: 0/7, 0/6, and 0/7 participants in the respective GWP42003 groups and 0/5 on placebo; deaths not reported.
